senses.gloss: वट् váṭ, a sacrificial exclamation (YV., rare).
वाट् vā́ṭ, a sacrificial exclamation = bring 🞄or take [prob. fr. √ vāh = √ vah].
वट्ट vaṭṭa, m. N.: -deva, m. N..
वाट 1. vāṭa, a. made of the Indian fig-tree 🞄(vaṭa): -mūla, a. dwelling at the roots of the 🞄Indian fig-tree.

वटारक vaṭāra-ka, m. (?), ā, f. cord (rare);
 🞄(a) -maya, a. made of cord (noose).
वटिका vaṭikā, f. kind of perforated rice 🞄cake.

वाटिका vāṭ-ikā, f. enclosure, garden;
 -ī, 🞄f. id..
वटेश्वर vaṭa‿īśvara, m. N. of a Liṅga.

वाट्य vāṭ-ya, 〈1.〉 a. made of the Indian figtree 🞄(vaṭa);
 〈2.〉 m. roasted barley.
